intentional_divergences: A nonempty stored OTP is required; empty/cleared OTP cannot verify.
Wrong OTP returns 400 with readable error rather than mojibake/500.
Auth verify requires Bearer transport and HS256; non-Bearer token rejected.
Malformed login credentials return controlled 401; registration requires string fields.
Database errors return generic 500 without raw DB details.
Downstream calls have bounded timeouts and no automatic write retries.
